name: Donear Industries Limited
summary: Donear Industries Limited manufactures fabrics in India and internationally. The company offers fabrics in various finishes, including wrinkle and odor resistance, moisture absorbent, and 4-way stretch; and ready-to-wear products, such as shirts, t-shirts, trousers, denims, suits, traditional wear, sports and Nehru jackets, corduroy, workwear, and accessories under the Donear Suitings, Mayur Suitings & Shirtings, Ferrino Mizzoni, Eurico, Vestito, D'Cot, and Donear NXG brands. It also provides dyed polyester and cotton yarns; and trades in garments. The company exports its products to approximately 20 countries. It serves automotive, aviation, industrial, defence, government bodies, and educational institutions through various channels, which include wholesale, retail, franchisees, agents, and dealers. Donear Industries Limited was founded in 1979 and is based in Mumbai, India.
